description: Devanarayana Acharige Suranga v. Hon. Attorney General Devanarayana Acharige Suranga v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. S. Devika De Livera Tennekoon, J
parties: Devanarayana Acharige Suranga v. Hon. Attorney General Devanarayana Acharige Suranga v. Hon. Attorney General View More
judgement_by: Hon. S. Devika De Livera Tennekoon, J
keywords: Criminal appeal – Attempted murder – Appeal limited to sentence – Trial in absentia – Disparity in sentence between co-accused – First accused pleaded guilty and received suspended sentence – Second accused tried in absentia and sentenced to 10 years rigorous imprisonment – Absconding/absence from trial not by itself a proper ground for imposing heavier punishment – Equality and proportionality in sentencing – Conviction affirmed – Ten-year sentence set aside – Two years rigorous imprisonment imposed and suspended for five years – Fine enhanced from Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 25,000 – Appeal partly allowed. P.R. Walgama J. agreed.
legistation: Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – section 331; Penal Code – sections 300 and 32.
